_note: Physics-based pools on the art grid (src/vfx/splat_shape.gd shape, src/vfx/pool_paint.gd drawing). A pool runs out from where it lands along its flight; walls and solid props stop it and its volume runs on along them (a corner fills, the open floor gets a stretched blot). squash = how flat it lies (the floor seen at a slant); momentum 0..1 = how far it keeps sliding along its flight; spread_time = s it takes to run out to its rim; edge_time = s its rim goes before its middle at the end; rebake_hz = how often a changing pool is shaded again at most; anim_hz = the frame rate of living materials (fire, lava); bake_budget_ms = ms per frame for working out and shading the fields again, in slices (the one waiting longest first, a new one at once; the last picture shows until the new one is done), so their costs do not pile up in one frame; lay_budget_ms = ms per frame for laying a pool into a field that holds cells already (from its middle out, far ahead of its spreading; on empty floor it goes in at once), lay_now_cells = a pool of at most this many cells is laid at once; catch_up_after_ms / catch_up_ms = a picture or pool waiting longer than this gets this many ms a frame instead of the budget above (a huge field does not lag far behind, the frames stay bounded); thread_cells = a pool of this many cells or more gets its shape worked out on a worker thread (see _field_note). materials: style (liquid, void, ice, fire, lava), droplets = drops a thrown splat flings ahead, bubbles = bubbles at a time, splash = what a landing pool throws (drops, chips, embers, none), ripple = speed of its rings (0 none), steps = wet steps behind waders, ramp = opaque colours by role (spec specular, hi highlight and north rim, lite light swirls, body, shade, deep south row and lip, outline). Materials are opaque (no alpha); see production/qa/evidence/crypt-vfx-review. void_pull = [pull, spin] px/s of a void pool's well (it pulls loose things in), void_motes = streaks circling in per second.

surface_motion._note: Cosmetic fixed-step spring mass shared by all fluid pool surfaces. Units documented in docs/SEELEN-MATERIE.de.md; gameplay cells stay authoritative.

physics._note: The living liquid (src/vfx/pool_paint.gd): a pool first seen within splash_window s of landing throws drops (drops_per_px of its radius, at most drop_max) at drop_speed px/s along its flight with drop_lift px/s upwards; a drop into its pool rings it, next to it joins it, on dry floor lies as a puddle for drop_dry s (drawing only). Rings run at ripple_speed art px/s (times the material's ripple) for ripple_life s (at most ripple_max per material), a crown jumps for crown_time s. Waders ring every wade_every s; out of a liquid with steps they leave steps wet steps, one per stride crypt px, that dry in step_dry s. User request 2026-10-30: liquids as physics. Burning ground lets fire_flames flames per cell and second rise (at most fire_flames_max per pool layer material). Materials: spread_scale slows the run-out (lava is thick: 3), glow = strength of the warm light breathing over the pool. Ice (materials crack, melt_to): a blow cracks it (at most crack_max cracks, healing over crack_life s), a frost burst freezes liquid rim first over freeze_time s, fire thaws it from its side, the nearest cells first, over thaw_time s (physics plan R25), ice that goes leaves melt water drying in water_dry s. Lightning into a liquid (electrify): arcs crawl over it for zap_time s in zap_cols. A puddle the game charged (src/combat/boss_moves.gd electrify, balance.json element; user request 2026-10-30: water and lightning make a puddle that works) crackles all over while charged: zap_charged_arcs arcs per 100 cells, zap_charged_len cells each, in zap_charged_cols.

reactions._note: Where two materials meet (keyed <style>+<style>; liquid = poison, blood, water): a_to / b_to say what becomes of each cell there: gone (hidden; drawing only, the game's hit test is untouched), crust (lava turns dark for crust_time s and glows up again), or a material name (a drawing-only cell of it); steam hisses every steam_every cells. A liquid on the hot floor (the Hell's lava tiles) reacts as liquid+lava. A key of two material names (water+blood) goes before the style pair: water meeting blood shows bloodwater, water meeting poison toxicwater (drawing-only mix colours, physics plan F21). Material plague: the Seuchenfeld's pool (talents.json curse_7 "pool"; its tick reaches whoever stands in it, physics plan R14). User decision 2026-10-30: reactions visible only.

_field_note: The gameplay field (src/physics_kit/pool_field.gd PoolField, BAUPLAN M1d) is the truth of what lies where (materials_at, covers); src/vfx/pool_paint.gd draws it. It runs only on the host's clock. A pool of thread_cells cells or more is shaped on a worker thread and counts (and shows) from max(shape_commit_s, shape_commit_per_1000_cells_s per thousand cells) s after the field first saw it, on every machine the same: at that moment the field waits for the worker if it is not done (measured 2026-11-01 in the Hölle: a thrown poison potion of 5003 cells took its worker 222 ms, about 44 ms per thousand cells, the open-floor test being two thirds of it; 0.066 leaves half as much again). purge_every_s = how often the field forgets cells whose time is over (s).
_crust_note: floor_crust (pool_paint.gd lava_rim, review A6 2026-11-01): the worlds drawn with these sprite sets (the Hölle) show their lava floor's edge as a ragged crust of pixels instead of the straight stone frame: cooled rock reaching depth [min, max] art px into the melt (wandering along the edge) and rounding its outer corners off (a quarter circle of round art px), cracks glowing through it where its noise passes cracks (0..1), rock spilt up to spill art px onto the floor and cinders (share) beyond. Drawing only. A material's look (here poison: miasma) is how it is drawn while its style keeps its rules and reactions: a miasma is a see-through sludge under its own fumes, its veil [cover cap, alpha where thin, alpha where thick], its grain churning churn_hz times a second, fumes = wisps rising off it (max, one per per_cells cells, life s, rise and sway in art cells, alpha).
_custom_shape_note: Hollow soul rings and narrow authored trails keep the prior short material arrival (0.1 s maximum logical worker commit), rather than the full enclosing-disc delay. Ordinary material pools retain shape_commit_per_1000_cells_s.
